name: Polyhedron Rasterization Voxelization
definition: An extension of the 2D method to convert 3D polyhedra into a 3D voxel grid. It uses faces (planar polygons) as boundaries between solids instead of edges.
summary: Polyhedron Rasterization Voxelization converts 3D polyhedra into a sparse voxel grid by rasterizing planar faces and using XOR operations to mark boundaries, deferring interior filling to a second stage.
